symptom: Usage or rate limit invisible to the watcher; workers sit in opencode retry and look "busy"
evidence: oc.log:436092, 488378, 497909, 510070, 535854; smoketest REPORT "Interrupted"; 2239 REPORT "cause unknown"
root_cause: auto.py:299-301 `busy_ids` counts `type!="idle"` as busy, so the `retry` status is hidden; auto.py:447-457 classifies only finished-message errors; the PAUSED path (L37 policy) never fires
impact: 2239: 211+171 min × 5 workers ≈ 32 worker-h; night25 ≈ 3 h; 1553 ≈ 1.2 h × 2 workers + master; 2031 5 min
fix: Add `retry_ids(url)` returning `{sid: s}` where `s["type"]=="retry"`. In `poll_workers`, when `LIMIT_RE.search(s.get("message",""))` matches: set `st["limit_since"]`, append event `LIMIT: <n> sessions in provider retry (<msg>); next try <s["next"]>. Holding spawns and the harness queue.`, and log `limit_seen`. `cmd_spawn` and `cmd_harness` refuse while `st["limit_since"]` is set. Run `master_queue.py pause` (new subcommand, or `set paused`) so no paid run starts. Clear the flag when no session is in retry for 2 polls, then append `LIMIT CLEARED`
test: Fake HTTP server in `/tmp/R5-auto-*/fake_oc.py` serving `/global/health` ok and `/session/status` → `{"ses_x":{"type":"retry","attempt":2,"message":"This request would exceed your account's rate limit","next":<ms>}}`. Run `watch_once` with `AUTO_DIR` etc. on fake paths and assert the LIMIT event, `limit_since` set, and `cmd_spawn` raising AutoError
detection: Any session status `retry` whose message matches LIMIT_RE, on 1 poll → LIMIT event and hold

root_cause: run-with-subscription.sh:748-807: a 4-token probe returns 200 even with ~0 headroom. master_queue.py:616-631 detects the limit only after the run process exits. auto.py `cmd_harness` (1038-1080) has no budget check. No budget rule in AUTO_POLICY

fix: (a) Policy budget rule (section 3). (b) `cmd_harness` refuses while `st["limit_since"]` is set, or when more than `budget.workers_with_run` workers are busy. (c) Preflight logs `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-*` headers from the probe response and refuses above X% use. The bridge already parses these headers (scripts/tests/test_claude_oauth_errors.py:54,95); UNVERIFIED that a 200 carries them. (d) master_queue `tick` tails the running log; on the first `accounts exhausted` it kills the run at once and requeues

detection: Limit event (R5-01) or bridge 429 → no `harness add`; a running harness log line `exhausted` → kill+requeue

symptom: Harness auto-resume scheduled before the reset; would burn another try

detection: resume time < parsed reset → refuse, log it
